Bai hoc apply_code + 1 bug that cua pipeline-worker (CONTEXT_PATH_PATTERN nuot dau cau sau @path) da ghi tai docs/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md va docs/INCIDENTS.md #19 (bug do da duoc sua + deploy 2026-08-24, khong can dung lai apply_code cho 2 bug device.routes.js vi da sua tay xong).
